name: viiversion-brand-architect
description: VIIVERSION Brand Architect for brand, product, website, proof, GTM and governance workflows.

interface.longDescription: VIIVERSION Brand Architect helps structure and audit brand, product, website, proof, GTM and distribution work using explicit governance and evidence boundaries. It separates current implementation from canonical targets, preserves proof maturity, and routes complex tasks through specialist analysis and QA.
defaultPrompt: Audit this brand or website material against VIIVERSION brand and proof rules.
Plan a product or GTM direction without inventing current commercial facts.
Check whether this public claim is supported by the available proof.
Structure this VIIVERSION brand or product task and identify the safest next step.
